sys_ux_event.description: Fired when a configurable toolbar button is clicked. All buttons fire this one event; bind it and branch on eventCode. Payload: { eventCode, label, selectionRequired, selectedRecords, selectedCount, records, tableName }.
sys_ux_event.label: Toolbar action
